title: MCP (Model Context Protocol): how agents reach tools, and where you can stop them
summary: Microsoft documents preview Graph automation for publisher-type access and user access, but the page incorrectly marks both as undocumented. The printed admin paths and commands are supported; the Managed Environment prerequisite also needs to acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance.

Set mode to applyOnce and include baseline.resources with resourceType microsoft.agent.allowedagenttypes, resourceVersion 1 and properties.valueObject containing areMicrosoftAppsAllowed, areTenantScopedAppsAllowed, areISVAppsAllowed and, where needed, areMicrosoftCertifiedThirdPartyAppsAllowed.
